definitions.full: H5884. En Rimmon רִמּוֺן עֵין proper name, of a location in post-exile Judah Neh 11:29 (A ( εν ) Πεμμιον ), probably= III. עַיִן 2 q. v. and רִמּוֺן Zech 14:10 .
